name: PolyRush : VR Multiplayer Racing
summary:
PolyRush is an online multiplayer racing game built for Meta Quest. Pick your car, drop into a live global lobby with real players, and fight for position on fast, technical circuits. Arcade handling — brake late, slide the corner, slipstream the straights to make the pass. Easy to learn. Hard to win.
